name: Seasonal porch decor packages
one_liner: Done-for-you Halloween and autumn porch displays (pumpkins, gourds, styling) sold as fixed-price packages that customers pay for upfront.
customer: Affluent homeowners in suburban areas who want a festive porch without the effort
offer: Tiered packages: drop-off only, or drop-off plus design, with add-ons such as end-of-season removal
how_it_makes_money: Fixed package prices of $325, $525, $800 and $1,350, design add-on of $75, custom jobs from $3,500. Paid upfront, and roughly 50% of revenue is profit
startup_cost: low (title says $0; customers pay upfront, which funds stock)
time_to_first_revenue: Weeks: one season, using a flyer and social media
evidence: Heather (Dallas) says 'Our sales were just at $100,000' and the video claims '$100,000 of profit per month' in peak season (vvtsOOGn6Io)
Package one is $1,350, package two $800, package three $525, package four $325, design add-on $75 (vvtsOOGn6Io)
'95% of my clients do add design' for packages three and four (vvtsOOGn6Io)
Customers pay upfront, so risk is close to zero (vvtsOOGn6Io)
risks: Only a 4-6 week season each year
The UK porch-decor culture is much smaller than in the US, so willingness to pay is unproven
Needs physical logistics and pumpkin sourcing
Could extend to Christmas, but that is not in the transcript

name: Remote-managed cleaning company
one_liner: A local residential cleaning brand where the founder handles marketing, booking and customer communication, and independent cleaners do the jobs.
customer: Homeowners and busy households who want weekly, fortnightly or monthly cleans
offer: Recurring home cleaning booked online, delivered by self-employed cleaners
how_it_makes_money: Customer pays per clean and the cleaner is paid per job. The operator keeps a 50-60% margin, and customers typically stay 1-2 years on a recurring schedule
startup_cost: low (the founders started their window cleaning business with $150)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown (weeks, once ads and the first cleaner are in place)
evidence: 'You basically get to keep a 50 to 60% margin on the job, and the whole thing runs from a laptop' (8XSaVl6QnVA)
Customers 'usually stay 1 to 2 years' (8XSaVl6QnVA)
Two people working 9-5 jobs at a furniture store make '$60,000 a month' with the model (p6mYFoY7fQE)
The founders' house cleaning company passed '$1M in total sales'; their window cleaning business went from $150 to $65K/month (p6mYFoY7fQE)
Same remote-operator model for building services (ejCWJqJ8nKk)
risks: Google Ads competition in big cities
Results quoted are from course sellers, so expect bias

name: Bottleless water cooler rental to offices
one_liner: Place mains-fed filtered water coolers in offices on multi-year rental contracts.
customer: Office managers, building managers, small businesses that still use jugs
offer: Cooler rental including filters, cleaning and repairs
how_it_makes_money: About $50 per cooler per month on auto-renewing contracts of 1-5 years. Filters cost $50-100 every 6 months
evidence: Yale case on Quench: about $50/month per cooler, around 9 in 10 on auto-renewing 1-5 year agreements, average customer stays about 10 years (nGsl9pZOh_E)
Placement cost about $1,100 per cooler (nGsl9pZOh_E)
Carolina Pure Water grew past 2,200 customers and was acquired by Quench in 2019 (nGsl9pZOh_E)
The 'Harry' example (18 coolers, about $900/month) is a dramatised story, so treat as illustrative
risks: Competing on price destroys the margin

name: Commercial scent diffuser subscription
one_liner: Install scent diffusers in customer-facing businesses and charge a monthly fee that covers oil refills.
customer: Salons, boutiques, gyms, hotels, dental waiting rooms
offer: Diffuser placement plus monthly oil refills
how_it_makes_money: $100-500 per month per site. Oil costs about $30-40/month for a small unit
startup_cost: low ($150-250 per small diffuser; $600-2,500 for HVAC units)
time_to_first_revenue: A few weeks to first host
evidence: 'Scent marketing programs... run $100 to $500 a month', according to Powerhouse Home & Commercial Services, Austin (nGsl9pZOh_E)
ScentAir has been doing this since the mid-90s (nGsl9pZOh_E)
risks: Customers may cancel to save money
Evidence is pricing only, with no small-operator revenue case

name: Restaurant knife sharpening route
one_liner: Collect and sharpen restaurant and household knives in batches, with a minimum order per pickup.
how_it_makes_money: $10-20 per knife with a $150 pickup minimum. Cost per knife is about $0.40
time_to_first_revenue: 2-3 weeks of practice, then the first restaurant account
evidence: Michael Kemp (Austin): about $25K in the first 6 months and about $60K in year 1 (8YO27121ydQ)
'10 or 12 knives take him about 90 minutes' (8YO27121ydQ)

name: Weekend party & event equipment rental
one_liner: Rent bounce houses, marquees, tables and chairs for weekend events, stored at home.
customer: Parents hosting birthdays, schools, churches, wedding/event organisers
offer: Delivered and set-up inflatables, tents and furniture packages
startup_cost: medium ($800-2,000 used inflatable; $12,500 documented starter set; tent $2,500-4,500)
evidence: Solo operator: $12,500 start, about $28K in year 1, about 28% net margin (4x4wvrOyAIk)
Adam Keller: about $30K in his first summer with tents/tables (4x4wvrOyAIk)
'80 to 90% of all inflatable revenue happens between Friday and Sunday' (4x4wvrOyAIk)
risks: Insurance and safety (PIPA inspection in the UK)
Seasonal, and the UK weather is a problem

name: Furniture flipping
one_liner: Buy solid-wood furniture cheap, repaint it and resell it on Marketplace.
customer: People furnishing homes or first flats
how_it_makes_money: Buy at $40-120 and sell at $325-525. Net about $100-250 per dresser
evidence: Sarah Chen: an extra $2.5-3K/month (8YO27121ydQ)
Claire McCann: $35K profit over 15 months (8YO27121ydQ)
5-10 pieces a week earns $2-5K/month, per Commonplace (8YO27121ydQ)

name: LinkedIn branded carousel maker micro-SaaS
one_liner: A simple web app that turns consultants' content into on-brand LinkedIn document carousels.
customer: Independent consultants who post LinkedIn carousels regularly
offer: Carousel editor with brand kit and export
how_it_makes_money: Subscription assumed (no pricing in the transcript)
evidence: Weak evidence: the idea was suggested by AI research in a tool demo, with no revenue or demand data (MpbxMuH3VHk)
risks: The video is a funnel for a course
